map.按人数、同时在线设备、主要用途与面积，用固定规则给出带宽区间、设备与覆盖建议；同: Use fixed rules on household size, concurrent devices, main usage and area to recommend bandwidth, equipment and coverage; the same inputs always give the same result.
map.按常住人数、同时在线设备、主要用途与房屋面积，用固定规则推荐带宽区间、每设备可用: Use fixed rules on household size, concurrent devices, main usage and floor area to recommend a bandwidth range, per-device usable bandwidth, router/ONT and coverage; address coverage and live plans are not verified.
map.填写常住人数（1–20 整数）与同时在线设备数（1–100 整数）。: Enter household size (integer 1–20) and concurrent devices (integer 1–100).
map.选择主要用途：日常、远程办公、4K、游戏、直播上传或智能家居。: Choose the main usage: daily, remote work, 4K, gaming, live upload or smart home.
map.读取估算需求、推荐带宽区间、低档每设备分摊、覆盖与设备建议。: Read estimated demand, recommended bandwidth range, per-device share at the lower tier, coverage and equipment advice.
map.租房或搬家前把需求整理成可沟通的带宽区间。: Before renting or moving, turn your needs into a bandwidth range you can discuss.
map.和家人、室友解释为什么要选某档带宽与 mesh。: Explain to family or roommates why a certain tier and mesh are needed.
map.下单前做需求对照，再向运营商确认地址覆盖与套餐。: Use it as a needs check before ordering, then confirm address coverage and plans with the ISP.
map.估算需求 =（50 + 3×10 + 6×5）×1.0 = 110 Mbps；留: Estimated demand = (50 + 3×10 + 6×5)×1.0 = 110 Mbps; with 1.2× headroom → 132 Mbps, choose the 200 Mbps tier and show 300 Mbps as the range. Usable at the lower tier is 170 Mbps, about 28.3 Mbps per device for six devices. For 90 m², use a Wi-Fi 6 dual-band router plus a gigabit ONT.
map.规则固定，不再随机抽取组合；标称带宽按 85% 折算；无法离线确认地址覆盖与实时: Rules are fixed with no random combinations; nominal bandwidth is derated to 85%; address coverage and live prices cannot be confirmed offline, so rely on the ISP survey and published plans.
map.为什么结果稳定了？: Why is the result stable now?
map.新版按固定公式计算，同一输入必然得到同一结果，便于复核。: The new version uses a fixed formula, so identical inputs always produce the same result for review.

map.设备数怎么填？: How should device count be entered?
map.填同时在线的最坏情况设备数，而不是家中设备总数。: Enter the worst-case number of concurrent devices, not the total number of devices at home.
